The '''Mimetic Combat Processor''' was a device that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[PROXY]] was equipped with. It possessed a remarkable capacity, utilized in sync with PROXY's holographic projectors, it enabled him to convincingly and accurately emulate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] warriors and their combat styles.
